title: Second moment of a random Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S$ be any subset of the $n$ coordinates. Choose a Boolean function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the signs uniformly from all such functions, and regard its values as real numbers. The expected square of its Fourier coefficient at $S$ is $2^{-n}$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is any finite set of coordinates in the cube
